title: Damaged Clothing Refund Policy
policy_text: Delivered clothing with a visible tear, hole, stain, or broken zip may be refunded within 30 days when image evidence matches the ordered product.

title: Wrong Item Refund Policy
policy_text: An incorrect delivered item may be refunded within 14 days when the received product and order record do not match.

title: No Visible Damage Policy
policy_text: A damage claim is not eligible for automatic refund when submitted evidence shows no visible damage.

title: Final Sale Exclusion
policy_text: Final-sale products are excluded from refunds unless required by applicable consumer law.
